findings.location: source.html, first poem, lines beginning “Away from my heart”
findings.source_quote: Away from my heart, / That it tarnish no more
findings.suggested_fix: Retain the sense that the removed ugliness will no longer tarnish the heart, for example: «Fra hjertet mitt, / så det ikke lenger blir tilsmusset».
findings.translation_quote: Fra hjertet mitt, / Så det ikke lenger flekker,

findings.suggested_fix: Use «prydet med hans mildhet» or another Bokmål rendering of meekness that conveys gentleness, rather than humility.
